A signed-in user's upload is received by `POST /api/v1/files/`, handled by `upload_file` (`backend/open_webui/routers/files.py:271-291`), gated by `Depends(get_verified_user)` at `files.py:279`. It immediately delegates to `upload_file_handler` (`files.py:315`), which reads the allowed-extensions config (`files.py:345-353`) and calls `Storage.upload_file(file.file, filename, tags)` at `files.py:366`. With the default local provider, `LocalStorageProvider.upload_file` (`backend/open_webui/storage/provider.py:59-67`) reads all bytes with `file.read()` (`provider.py:61`) and writes them with `open(file_path, 'wb').write(contents)` into `UPLOAD_DIR/<uuid>_<filename>` (`provider.py:64-66`), where `UPLOAD_DIR = DATA_DIR / 'uploads'` (`backend/open_webui/config.py:168`). A `File` row (id, storage path, size, sha-256 hash, content-type) is then inserted via `Files.insert_new_file` (`files.py:399-419`).

If `process=True` (the default), `process_uploaded_file` runs — in the background via `background_tasks.add_task` (`files.py:428-436`) or inline (`files.py:439-447`) — which routes the content into `process_file` (`backend/open_webui/routers/retrieval.py:1837`) to chunk and embed it into the vector DB collection `file-{id}` (or, for audio content-types, first transcribes via `routers/audio.py`'s `transcribe`, called at `files.py:154-160`). If the client-supplied metadata includes a `knowledge_id` the user has write access to, the file is also auto-linked into that Knowledge Collection (`files.py:204-245`). Finally, back in `upload_file`, an `EVENTS.FILE_UPLOADED` event (defined `backend/open_webui/events.py:287-289`) is published via `publish_event` at `files.py:305-311`, notifying any subscribers that a file was uploaded.
